verdict_text: YES. The script casts exactly the 112 named projection matrices to bfloat16 via a precise regex, leaves all other tensors (including embed_tokens and lm_head) as float32, and the buffer regex `(?!)` never matches so nothing is dropped — consistent with there being no buffers to delete. The four required assertions run before `save_sharded_safetensors`, satisfying the "fail loudly before writing" requirement, and sharding/index generation is delegated to the shared `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors` with the correct 268,435,456-byte cap.
